title: carrying groceries inside

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Let's carry the groceries in one trip.
turns.zh: 我們一趟就把買的東西全搬進去吧。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: A. The milk is for tomorrow. B. We'll need another pair of hands. C. That bag came from the bakery.
turns.zh: A. 牛奶是明天要用的。 B. 那還需要再找個人來幫忙。 C. 那一袋是麵包店買的。
